reference_method: Selected Vietnamese phrases were manually checked against the rendered source page; this is not a full-page transcription.
protocol: Copy each selected region from its source PDF page, rasterize it to remove any embedded OCR text layer, then run the existing DocumentProcessor PDF path with separate page-text and table render scales. Score source text chunks without generated structured-table serialization; score tables separately against supplied row/cell anchors.
limitations: Production-parser OCR path only. Smoke fixtures verify extraction behavior but are not representative model-selection evidence or business evidence. This run has no explicitly annotated cell coordinates. There is no paired OCR-engine comparison. Throughput includes parser/OCR invocation but excludes application embedding and database persistence.
